answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the island queue naming the violet that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 4 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Because of that, every alias costs 4 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the orchard record exposes exactly who is still on probation. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
